mapper.select: select b.*, btr.id as btr_id, btr.business_id as btr_business_id, btr.user_id as btr_user_id, btr.track_status as btr_track_status, btr.key_items as btr_key_items, btr.next_time as btr_next_time, btr.record as btr_record, btr.create_time as btr_create_time, u.name as btr_assign_name from business b left join business_track_record btr on b.id = btr.business_id left join user u on btr.user_id = u.id where b.id = #{id} order by btr.create_time desc

select count(1) as business_total, count(if(status = 1, 1, null)) as business_wait_allot, count(if(status = 2, 1, null)) as business_wait_follow, count(if(status = 3, 1, null)) as business_following, count(if(status = 4, 1, null)) as business_false, count(if(status = 5, 1, null)) as business_convert_customer from business;
